title: 29 Royal Fern Way Vacation Rental
meta_description: 29 Royal Fern Way is a 4.00 bedroom, 4.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Description Welcome to 29 Royal Fern Way, an elegant retreat perfectly situated in the heart of WaterColor's Forest District. Designed for both comfort and flexibility, this beautifully crafted four-bedroom home with a dedicated bunk room and private office provides the ideal layout for families and groups seeking space, convenience, and coastal style. With timeless architecture, high-end finishes, and access to all of WaterColor's world-class amenities, this home offers an exceptional 30A experience. Property Highlights Exclusive Access to the WaterColor Beach Club and Community Pools with Up to 10 Passes Included 6-Passenger Electric Cart Included in Rental 4 Adult Bikes Included in Rental Parking for 2 Vehicles (Garage Access Available) Natural Gas Grill Screened Porch with Outdoor Seating and Dining Private Office Gourmet Kitchen with Thermador Appliances 5-Minute Bike Ride to Camp WaterColor 4-Minute Bike Ride to WaterColor Beach Club Access 5-Minute Bike Ride to Seaside Experience the Home 29 Royal Fern Way welcomes guests with a classic coastal exterior and a charming paver walkway leading to a covered front porch illuminated by gas lanterns. Inside, the home opens to a soaring 25-foot foyer that makes an immediate impression. French doors reveal a private study, while the main living space flows seamlessly into a spacious dining area and gourmet kitchen. The open-concept design features high ceilings, hardwood floors, and shiplap accents throughout. Expansive windows bring in natural light and views of the surrounding greenery, creating a peaceful atmosphere for gathering and relaxation. The living area includes plush seating, a large television, and direct access to the screened porch, which offers a comfortable space for evening dining or quiet mornings with coffee. The kitchen is both elegant and functional, with Thermador appliances, white custom cabinetry, quartz countertops, and a coastal tile backsplash. A large center island with bar seating provides the perfect spot for casual meals or conversation, while the formal dining area sets the stage for shared dinners. A built-in desk nook and adjacent laundry area add thoughtful convenience. The first-floor primary suite serves as a private retreat, featuring shiplap detailing and an en-suite bathroom with dual vanities, a soaking tub, and a walk-in shower. Upstairs, a cozy loft creates a second living area ideal for movie nights or reading. A dedicated bunk room provides additional sleeping arrangements for children or extra guests. 29 Royal Fern Way delivers the ultimate balance of style, comfort, and location, allowing guests to enjoy everything WaterColor has to offer with ease. Sleeping Arrangements First Floor Primary Bedroom: King Bed (Sleeps 2), Private Bathroom with Soaking Tub and Walk-In Shower Kitchen Living Room Dining Area Laundry Room Half Bathroom Private Office with a Sleeper Sofa (Sleeps 2) Second Floor Guest Bedroom: King Bed (Sleeps 2), Private Bathroom with Walk-In Shower Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed (Sleeps 2), Private Bathroom with Walk-In Shower Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed (Sleeps 2), Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo Bunk Room: One Twin-Over-Twin Bunk Bed (Sleeps 2), Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo Additional Living Area Life in WaterColor Located in the Forest District, 29 Royal Fern Way provides convenient access to WaterColor's top amenities, including the Beach Club, Camp WaterColor, tennis courts, and scenic trails. The home's central location allows guests to walk or bike to local dining and shopping, while the nearby Gulf beaches and Seaside community are just minutes away. Whether relaxing on the porch, exploring 30A by bike, or enjoying sunset dinners at the Beach Club, this home is designed to make every moment unforgettable.
